generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Oxalidales page (read 2026-10-16): corolla contorted, petals clawed; claws held together form a funnel (my reading).

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Oxalidales page, Oxalidaceae (read 2026-10-16): Oxalis trifoliolate or palmate; pinnate in Averrhoideae and Biophytum.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: flowers complete, regular, 5-merous; sepals imbricated; stamens 10, filaments somewhat dilated and united at base; ovary superior, 5-celled; styles 5, distinct.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 332 Oxalidaceae: herbs or undershrubs; leaves alternate or basal, digitately or pinnately compound, rarely simple by loss of leaflets, the leaflets often folding at night; stipules absent; fruit a capsule.

traits.inflorescence.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 318, family Oxalidaceae: inflorescence cyme; read as "cyme".

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Oxalidaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded often a rhizome, often tubers. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py with character 25 added); states the authors do not qualify, side by side, read as often.
